tools.name: bhashafix_inspect_project
tools.description: Inspect framework and localisation infrastructure without executing project scripts.

tools.name: bhashafix_list_locales
tools.description: Validate and describe BCP 47 locales using platform standards.

tools.name: bhashafix_crawl_routes
tools.description: Crawl a URL under the BhashaFix URL and SSRF policy.

tools.name: bhashafix_extract_strings
tools.description: Extract visible strings and context from supplied HTML.

tools.name: bhashafix_create_scan
tools.description: Create a validated AtlasPay scan request without claiming that execution has started.

tools.name: bhashafix_run_scan
tools.description: Execute a previously created scan request and persist genuine deterministic evidence.

tools.name: bhashafix_scan_project
tools.description: Run the deterministic AtlasPay localisation scan and persist its evidence.

tools.name: bhashafix_get_scan
tools.description: Read a persisted scan by explicit scan ID.

tools.name: bhashafix_list_issues
tools.description: List evidence-backed issues for a persisted scan.

tools.name: bhashafix_get_issue
tools.description: Read one issue from an explicit scan.

tools.name: bhashafix_check_translation
tools.description: Run deterministic placeholder and optional glossary checks.

tools.name: bhashafix_generate_virtual_preview
tools.description: Generate a protected deterministic specimen for a sandboxed synthetic localisation preview.

tools.name: bhashafix_suggest_translation
tools.description: Provider-routed linguistic operation. Returns an honest unavailable result when no provider is configured.

tools.name: bhashafix_generate_translation
tools.description: Provider-routed linguistic operation. Returns an honest unavailable result when no provider is configured.

tools.name: bhashafix_prepare_repair
tools.description: Prepare an allowlisted repair and return its diff without mutation.

tools.name: bhashafix_apply_repair
tools.description: Apply explicitly selected allowlisted repairs. Dry-run is the default; mutation requires the exact prepared diff hash.

tools.name: bhashafix_verify_repair
tools.description: Rerun identical predicates and return verification status.

tools.name: bhashafix_generate_report
tools.description: Generate portable reports for an explicit scan.

prompts.name: localise_project
prompts.description: Inspect the project, identify source and target locales, extract strings, then generate only provider-backed translations and verify the rendered result.

prompts.name: audit_localisation
prompts.description: Run deterministic localisation checks first, then separate model-assisted findings by confidence and human-review requirement.

prompts.name: repair_verified_issues
prompts.description: Prepare a repair for explicit verified issue IDs, inspect the unified diff, apply only after confirmation, then rerun identical predicates.

prompts.name: review_translation_quality
prompts.description: Review meaning, formality, brand voice and context. Treat subjective findings as recommendations with confidence, not facts.

prompts.name: prepare_release_report
prompts.description: Verify blocking issues, source-locale regression, accessibility and diff policy before generating the release report.
